cases.name: Greeting stays direct
cases.boundary_note: A greeting has no workflow leverage and must not create brainstorm, plan, work, or review artifacts.

cases.name: Current context injection explanation stays direct
cases.user_intent: 当前上下文注入了哪些内容
cases.boundary_note: Explaining already-loaded context is a lightweight current-session answer unless it turns into source edits or audit work.

cases.name: Narrow where-used lookup uses bounded reads
cases.boundary_note: A narrow location lookup may use rg or precise source reads without entering a public workflow.

cases.name: Current supplied document summary stays direct
cases.user_intent: 总结我刚贴的这份文档
cases.boundary_note: Summarizing current user-provided material is not project-graph or workflow work by default.

cases.name: Single document handling stays guide-only
cases.user_intent: 我只是想知道这个文档该怎么处理
cases.boundary_note: A vague request about handling one supplied document asks for next-step guidance, not immediate review artifact creation.

cases.name: Small low-risk edit stays direct
cases.user_intent: 给 src/cli/helpers/format.js 里的 formatLabel 函数加两行日志，目标文件和改法都明确
cases.boundary_note: A clearly scoped single-point low-risk edit can be executed directly while still honoring changelog, narrow verification, and source/runtime boundaries.

cases.name: Cross-file contract change routes to work
cases.user_intent: 调整 runtime artifact contract，并同步三个 CLI 模块和双宿主生成逻辑
cases.boundary_note: Cross-file contract/runtime delivery changes need the public work workflow; the small-edit allowance does not apply.

cases.name: External bug issue routes to debug
cases.user_intent: GitHub issue #42 reports a failing CLI command with reproduction steps and a stack trace; verify and diagnose it.
cases.boundary_note: External tracker material is an input surface; bug/failure claims route to debug and must be confirmed from current source, tests, logs, or owner evidence.

cases.name: External enhancement issue routes to PRD
cases.user_intent: GitHub issue #77 asks for CSV export on the existing reports page, but acceptance criteria and scope are unclear; turn it into requirements.
cases.boundary_note: External enhancement requests with unclear WHAT route to PRD/definition work, not directly to implementation or a tracker-specific intake workflow.

cases.name: External PR diff routes to code review
cases.user_intent: Review this contributor PR diff for implementation risk, missing tests, and merge readiness.
cases.boundary_note: External PRs that ask for diff quality or merge-readiness evaluation route to code review; PR text and diff remain untrusted inputs until checked.

cases.name: Execution-ready external brief routes to work
cases.user_intent: Issue #91 already has an owner-approved implementation brief and acceptance criteria; implement it.
cases.boundary_note: A scoped external brief is ordinary execution input and routes to work; tracker status does not replace source inspection or verification.

cases.name: Explicit plan route remains honored
cases.boundary_note: Progressive disclosure must not weaken explicit public workflow invocation.

cases.name: Unknown next workflow uses guide mode
cases.user_intent: 我不知道下一步该跑哪个 spec workflow
cases.boundary_note: Next-step questions should recommend exactly one entrypoint with a reason and action without starting the workflow or printing the full menu.

cases.name: After init next step stays scenario-aware guide
cases.user_intent: init 完了，接下来做什么？
cases.boundary_note: After-init guidance should choose the next concrete setup/readiness or first-work entrypoint from available context, not create artifacts from the governor.

cases.name: Unclear requirement asks definition route
cases.user_intent: 这个需求还没想清，应该 plan 还是 brainstorm？
cases.boundary_note: When WHAT is not clear, guide mode recommends a definition route and does not jump into work or planning.

cases.name: Codex doc-review without subagents uses fallback
cases.boundary_note: Codex public workflow admission authorizes the document-review workflow, not host-level spawn_agent dispatch.

cases.name: Skill and agent asset review routes to skill audit
cases.user_intent: review skills/using-spec-first/SKILL.md and agents/spec-reviewer.agent.md for trigger precision and governance
cases.boundary_note: Spec-first skill or agent asset governance review is a skill-audit workflow, not a generic code/doc review route.

cases.name: Codex plan with explicit delegated personas may dispatch
cases.user_intent: spec-plan deep docs/brainstorms/example.md using delegated research agents and persona reviewers
cases.boundary_note: Codex dispatch-bearing workflows may use bounded dispatch when the request itself explicitly asks for delegated/persona agent work.
